title: Fishfinder Sonar — Bait-Ball Detection
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishfinder:reading
| where target_strength_db>-45
| bin _time span=1min
| stats count as marks, avg(depth_m) as depth by _time
| where marks>10
| sort - _time
description: Flags the moments your sonar shows dense fish marks, mapping where and how deep the bait balls hold.
value: Turning raw sonar into logged hotspots helps you return to productive depths and structure another day.
implementation: Ingest fishfinder readings into `index=personal`; flag dense fish-mark periods and depth.
visualization: Time chart of sonar marks with depth of dense schools.
grandmaExplanation: It flags when your sonar shows lots of fish and how deep, so you can find them again.
